title: More Armor Trims
description: Adds 13 new armor trims to discover and collect
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FGNYBAJ6/images/d6764b0378493bf69be056f7e3aa3e28e9c6ab33.png)
If you thought that there could be more armor trims in Minecraft, you are just like me! And this mod is definitely for you, it adds new armor trims to the game, that are quite hard to obtain. Currently, ten new smithing templates added, but I am looking to add more.

_Mod reqiures [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)._

_For updates and teasers, you can join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/6d52nzVFJY) :D_

![Storm and Ram Armor Trim](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FGNYBAJ6/images/68eb54823c0cc597f13e3085f8711334718fa7d0.png)

<details>
<summary>How to obtain</summary>

Storm:
Obtained from fishing during a thunderstorm, as a treasure (33,3% chance as a treasure, aka 3,7% overall with Luck of the Sea III)

Ram:
Obtained from killing an Evoker riding a Ravager or vice versa from killing a Ravager that is ridden by an Evoker (100% chance)

Myth:
Obtained from a Wandering Trader for 15 emeralds, as a "Special" trade (which is 12,5% chance)

Greed:
Obtained from a minecart chest in a badlands mineshaft (20% chance)

Beast:
Obtained from a chest in an igloo basement (50% chance)

Fever:
Obtained from a chest in a ruined portal, the Nether variant (20% chance)

Wraith:
Obtained from killing a Wither in a Soul Sand Valley biome (100% chance)

Nihility:
Obtained from breaking a spawner in the Overworld (30% chance)

Horizon:
Obtained from brushing a suspicious gravel in cold ocean ruins (6,2% chance)

Origin:
Obtained from a sniffer digging it up in an Old Growth Taiga, pine or spruce variant (33,3% chance)

Twilight:
Obtained from a cat morning gift (11,4% chance)

Parasite:
Obtained from an endermite being killed by an enderman (20% chance)

Witness:
Obtained from breaking a naturally generated creaking heart during the night (20% chance)

</details>
